styles.hero: hard-edged low-poly 3D game character, sharp angular mesh with clearly visible flat triangle facets, no smooth surfaces, lanky stylized proportions about 6.5 heads tall, thin limbs, large ears, big dark heavy-lidded eyes, deadpan expression, oversized shoes, plain neutral gray studio background, soft even lighting
styles.map: chunky chibi 3D game character, short stubby body about 3 heads tall, oversized head, hands and sneakers, blocky voxel-like low-poly with crisp pixel-art textures, plain muted teal background
styles.prop: hard-edged low-poly 3D game prop, sharp angular mesh with clearly visible flat facets, painted flat textures, plain neutral gray studio background, soft even lighting

sheets.label: Hero turnaround
sheets.why: Front, 3/4, side and back of the same outfit, in the hard-faceted style. Used for modeling and image-to-3D. Once accepted, Claude crops a single front figure from it as this character's reference.
sheets.template: 3D character design reference sheet, the same character shown four times left to right: front view, three-quarter view, side profile, back view, identical outfit and hat in every view, full body standing straight, empty hands relaxed at sides, {LOOK}, {STYLE:hero}
sheets.params: --ar 16:9 --style raw --sref {HERO_SREF} {FACETED_SREF} --sw 250 --no text, labels, instrument, props, cropped feet, smooth shading, pixar style, plastic, glossy, subsurface skin, realistic

sheets.label: A-pose
sheets.why: One pose per image, front and side, for rigging. References the single-figure front crop only (no group-shot style refs), so Midjourney returns one character instead of a lineup.
sheets.template: full body 3D character model of one character standing in a neutral A-pose, {VARIANT}, arms straight and held out 45 degrees from the body, palms facing down, legs slightly apart, single character, centered, full figure in frame, {IDENTITY}, hard-edged low-poly 3D game character, sharp angular mesh with visible flat facets, no smooth surfaces, large ears, big dark heavy-lidded eyes, plain neutral gray studio background, soft even lighting
sheets.params: --ar 2:3 --style raw --sref {FACETED_SREF} --sw 250 {CHAR_REF:strong} --no multiple characters, lineup, turnaround, text, instrument, smooth shading, pixar style, plastic, glossy, subsurface skin, realistic

variants.label: Front
variants.text: front view facing the camera, perfectly symmetrical

sheets.label: Expressions
sheets.why: One face per image, square close-ups. Six emotions for battle reactions.
sheets.template: close-up portrait of one 3D game character, head and shoulders, facing the camera, {VARIANT}, {IDENTITY}, hard-edged low-poly 3D game character, sharp angular mesh with visible flat facets, no smooth surfaces, large ears, big dark heavy-lidded eyes, plain neutral gray studio background, soft even lighting
sheets.params: --ar 1:1 --style raw --sref {FACETED_SREF} --sw 250 {CHAR_REF:strong} --no multiple characters, lineup, text, full body, smooth shading, pixar style, plastic, glossy, subsurface skin, realistic

variants.label: Focused
variants.text: intense focused concentration, eyes narrowed, lips pressed

variants.label: Smug
variants.text: smug confident half grin, one eyebrow raised

variants.label: Triumphant
variants.text: triumphant shout, big open-mouth grin, eyes squeezed with joy

variants.label: Defeated
variants.text: defeated and deflated, eyes half closed, head tilted down, frown

sheets.label: Instrument
sheets.why: The drum alone in three views, modeled as a separate part. No character reference, so no person sneaks in.
sheets.template: game prop turnaround sheet of a single object: {INSTRUMENT}, shown three times: front view, side view, top-down view, isolated object, no people, {STYLE:prop}
sheets.params: --ar 16:9 --style raw --sref {FACETED_SREF} --no hands, people, character, text, smooth shading, pixar style, plastic, glossy, subsurface skin, realistic

sheets.label: Map version
sheets.why: Small, chunky version for the city map. Leads with the chibi proportions and uses only a light reference, so it keeps the outfit without copying the lanky body.
sheets.template: {STYLE:map}, turnaround sheet with front view, three-quarter view and back view, full body, holding {INSTRUMENT}, outfit: {IDENTITY}
sheets.params: --ar 16:9 --style raw --sref {MAP_SREF} --sw 100 {CHAR_REF:light} --no text, tall, lanky, thin limbs, separate props
